autosave.description: Autosave configuration changes when pool connection changes

donate_level.description: Donate level in percent (default 1%, i.e., 1 minute in 100 minutes)

tls_fingerprint.description: Pool TLS certificate fingerprint for strict certificate pinning

daemon_mode.description: Use daemon RPC instead of pool for solo mining

submit_to_origin.description: Also submit solution back to self-select URL

retries.description: Number of times to retry before switch to backup server

retry_pause.description: Time to pause between retries in seconds

dns_ipv6.description: Prefer IPv6 records from DNS responses

dns_ttl.description: TTL for internal DNS cache in seconds

api_port.description: Bind port for HTTP API (0 to disable)

api_full_access.description: Enable full remote access to HTTP API (only if access token set)

background.description: Run the miner in the background

use_syslog.description: Use system log for output messages

log_file.description: Log all output to a file

print_hashrate_interval.description: Print hashrate report every N seconds (0 to disable)

print_health_interval.description: Print health report every N seconds (0 to disable)

threads.description: Number of CPU threads (0 for auto)

cpu_affinity.description: Set process affinity to CPU core(s), mask 0x3 for cores 0 and 1

cpu_priority.description: Set process priority (0 idle, 2 normal to 5 highest)

cpu_max_threads_hint.description: Maximum CPU threads count (in percentage) hint for autoconfig

cpu_memory_pool.description: Number of 2 MB pages for persistent memory pool, -1 (auto), 0 (disable)

cpu_no_yield.description: Prefer maximum hashrate rather than system response/stability

hugepage_size.description: Custom hugepage size in kB (0 to disable)

huge_pages_jit.description: Enable huge pages support for RandomX JIT code

asm_optimizations.description: ASM optimizations: auto, none, intel, ryzen, bulldozer

argon2_impl.description: Argon2 implementation: x86_64, SSE2, SSSE3, XOP, AVX2, AVX-512F

randomx_init_threads.description: Threads count to initialize RandomX dataset (0 for auto)

randomx_1gb_pages.description: Use 1GB hugepages for RandomX dataset (Linux only)

randomx_wrmsr.description: Write custom value(s) to MSR registers or disable MSR mod (-1)

randomx_no_rdmsr.description: Disable reverting initial MSR values on exit

opencl_devices.description: Comma separated list of OpenCL devices to use

print_opencl_platforms.description: Print available OpenCL platforms and exit

cuda_devices.description: Comma separated list of CUDA devices to use

tls_gen_host.description: Generate TLS certificate for specific hostname

tls_cert_file.description: Load TLS certificate chain from a file in the PEM format

tls_cert_key_file.description: Load TLS certificate private key from a file in the PEM format

tls_dhparam_file.description: Load DH parameters for DHE ciphers from a file in the PEM format

tls_ciphers.description: Set list of available ciphers (TLSv1.2 and below)

tls_ciphersuites.description: Set list of available TLSv1.3 ciphersuites

pause_on_active_seconds.description: Pause mine when the user is active (resume after N seconds of last activity, 0 to disable)

stress_test.description: Run continuous stress test to check system stability

benchmark_iterations.description: Run benchmark, N can be between 1M and 10M

submit_benchmark.description: Perform an online benchmark and submit result for sharing

compare_hash.description: Compare benchmark result with specified hash
